newsitem.title: USA: Citgo Q4 profit rises as revenues increase.
newsitem.headline: Citgo Q4 profit rises as revenues increase.

text.p: Citgo Petroleum Corp on Wednesday said fourth-quarter net income rose to $47.2 million from $32.4 million in the same period a year earlier.

The Petroleos de Venezuela SA subsidiary said the gain reflected increased revenues of $3.7 billion, compared with revenues of $2.5 billion. Operating income rose to $101.1 million from $77.3 million.

For the year, Citgo reported net inclome of $127 million on revenues of $13 billion, compared with 1995 net income of $139.7 million on revenues of $10.6 billion. Income from operations fell to $311.2 million from $322.4 million.
"Overall, Citgo recorded a good, solid performance in spite of weak refining margins which plagued the industry for most of the year, Chief Executive Ralph S. Cunningham said.
"The company's Light Oils marketing operations turned in an exceptionally strong performance throughout the year."
He said the completion of a joint venture with Lyondell Petrochemical Co during the first half of 1997 and increased participation interest will be positive for the company.
"However, this new year has begun with the same weak refining margins which we experienced most of last year."
